strategies.name: Model spread vs market spread (no threshold)
strategies.rule: Bet the side when the originated margin differs from the stored market spread by at least Δ points, Δ = 0. Tie games push on whole numbers only.
strategies.why: The baseline that must exist before any threshold: if no Δ edge exists at Δ=0, a threshold only manufactures noise.
strategies.promote: Paired BSS interval lower bound above 0 on pre-kickoff rows with n ≥ 200.
strategies.kill: Interval straddles 0 after 400 graded legs, or the sign flips between the two independent estimators (ridge and Elo).

strategies.name: Model spread vs market spread (Δ ≥ 1.5)
strategies.rule: Same as S01 but only when |model − market| ≥ 1.5 points.
strategies.why: Tests whether selectivity helps or just shrinks n.
strategies.promote: Paired BSS interval lower bound above 0 with n ≥ 200 at Δ=1.5.
strategies.kill: BSS at Δ=1.5 is not better than Δ=0 after the multiplicity adjustment.

strategies.name: Model total vs market total
strategies.rule: Bet over when the originated total exceeds the stored total by ≥ 1.0 point, under by the same margin.
strategies.why: The total is a different quantity; it must be tested on its own rather than assumed.
strategies.promote: Paired BSS interval lower bound above 0 with n ≥ 200.
strategies.kill: Total MAE is worse than the market's MAE on the same rows.

strategies.name: Model win probability vs de-vigged moneyline
strategies.rule: Bet the side whose model probability exceeds the de-vigged market probability by ≥ 3 percentage points.
strategies.why: The moneyline is third because it inherits the margin model; it is a transform test, not an independent signal.
strategies.promote: Paired BSS interval lower bound above 0 with n ≥ 200.
strategies.kill: Model probabilities are less calibrated than the de-vigged market on the same rows.

strategies.name: Control: always take the home side
strategies.rule: Bet home on every pre-kickoff row, ignoring the model.
strategies.why: A rigged benchmark. If a model cannot beat 'always home', it carries no side skill.
strategies.promote: Never promoted. It exists to be beaten.

strategies.name: Control: always take the favourite
strategies.rule: Bet the side the market prices as favourite, ignoring the model.
strategies.why: The classic 'favourites only' control. Long-run losing at a vig, so a model that beats it has demonstrated something the crowd already prices.

strategies.name: Control: always take the underdog
strategies.rule: Bet the side the market prices as underdog.
strategies.why: The other side of the favourite control; a market with a strong favourite bias would make one of S06/S07 look skilful for the wrong reason.

strategies.name: Control: always take the over
strategies.rule: Bet over on every pre-kickoff row, ignoring the model.
strategies.why: Tests whether a total model is beating a coin, not a trend.

strategies.name: Two-leg same-week parlay (joint-evidence gate)
strategies.rule: Combine two legs only when a directly validated joint probability exists. Marginal probabilities may not be multiplied: dependence inside a game and across a slate makes the product wrong in both directions.
strategies.why: Parlays are where most claimed edges live and where they are least verifiable.
strategies.promote: A joint probability validated on held-out data, plus the operator's void and push rules, plus a settled sample with push handling.
strategies.kill: No joint estimate exists → the strategy stays BLOCKED, not 'promising'.
strategies.blocked_by: G07 joint-evidence gate: no validated joint probability is available.

strategies.name: Player-prop combination (joint-evidence gate)
strategies.rule: Rank a prop combination only when a directly validated joint probability and the operator's void/push rules are both available.
strategies.why: Props are correlated within a game (pace, game script, weather). Multiplying marginals is invalid.
strategies.promote: A validated joint model with held-out calibration and settled grading.
strategies.kill: No prop outcome feed exists → stays BLOCKED.
strategies.blocked_by: G07 + G08: no validated joint probability and no prop settlement feed.
